band_note: 55–69 Competent. Would move to ~74–77 Strong with ESP-account access confirming lifecycle depth, measurement rigor, and any behavioural segmentation.

evidence_notes.deliverability: SPF v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all (Klaviyo authenticates via DKIM per skill note, not SPF include). DMARC p=reject pct=100 with ruf reporting — best-in-class enforcement. BIMI not published (nice-to-have gap). Corpus auth pass 100% (SPF/DKIM/DMARC). Branded tracking trk.saxxunderwear.ca → CloudFront (Klaviyo standard) on 100% of sends.
evidence_notes.lifecycle: Corpus surfaces welcome (15% off), winback, cart/browse-abandon, and back-in-stock flow signals — 13 lifecycle-typed emails inside 155-msg window. Flow depth, branching, and flow-vs-campaign revenue split need ESP access.
evidence_notes.segmentation: Subject-line personalization tokens on only 1.3% of sends. No hreflang / no /fr/ locale despite Canadian brand — CA-French market unaddressed on the storefront. No observed variance suggesting behavioural or RFM segment splits from a single-subscriber vantage.
evidence_notes.campaign: 3.5 sends/week sustained over 310 days. Send-day skew Sunday-dominant (26% of sends) — unconventional and probably intentional given consumer-brand weekend browsing. Seasonal calendar visible (Valentine's, Father's Day, Cyber Monday, Winter Sale, Realtree collab). Content mix 73.5% promo / 16.8% editorial-education — promo-heavier than best-practice 50/50.
evidence_notes.offer: Ladder observed: 15% / 25% / 30% / 40%. Median 40%, but only 24.5% of sends carry any discount — three-quarters of sends are editorial or product-drop (non-margin-eroding). Bundle/multipack callouts on 27.7% of sends — differentiated offer construction, not pure blast-discount.
evidence_notes.creative: 31-char avg subject (mobile-optimised). 23.9% emoji, 14.2% urgency. Image-heavy sends 0% (favors deliverability + accessibility). Editorial mix present. Full creative quality needs visual inspection of rendered emails.
evidence_notes.conversion: 100% branded tracking via trk.saxxunderwear.ca (CloudFront-hosted, standard Klaviyo). Zero raw myshopify.com links. Zero marketplace redirects in the 8-email deep sample or the whole-corpus subject scan — the brief's marketplace/omnichannel angle wasn't in this subscriber's stream (could be segmented).
evidence_notes.measurement: Infra suggests capability (Klaviyo + branded tracking = clean attribution). Execution quality unverifiable without ESP.
evidence_notes.compliance: One-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058) on 100% of sends. Preferences link on 100%. Physical address (2015 Main St, Vancouver BC) on 100%. Fully CASL-compliant.

discovery_hooks: Klaviyo flow inventory + status — confirm the welcome, cart, browse, winback, and BiS depth
Flow-vs-campaign revenue split — the single number that would move Lifecycle from 3 to 4/5
Segment library + predictive analytics usage — does anything behind the scenes explain the low subject personalization?
Complaint / bounce / placement rates — completes the Deliverability picture
Marketplace segmentation — do Amazon/retail-partner subscribers get a different stream?
CA-French experiment feasibility — Klaviyo language branching + storefront hreflang
